title: KurbanChain: Hyperledger Fabric traceability system for qurban (source code and benchmark data)
description: KurbanChain is a permissioned-blockchain prototype on Hyperledger Fabric 2.5 that records the qurban (Eid al-Adha animal sacrifice) chain from the donor's wakalah contract and payment to the receipt of each meat parcel. This release contains the chaincode, the web application, scripts for a native (Docker-free) Fabric network, Hyperledger Caliper workloads, the raw results of every benchmark reported in the accompanying article, and scripts that summarize the results and recreate the article's performance figures. Source code: MIT License. Benchmark data and analysis outputs: CC BY 4.0.
notes: Funded by the Ministry of Higher Education, Science, and Technology of the Republic of Indonesia (Kemendiktisaintek) through the 2025 Fundamental Research grant scheme.
